title: Add bundled-tool schema keyword coverage
description:
Add coverage tests that compare bundled tool schemas against the custom provider-neutral schema validator.

Problem:
Eshyra intentionally uses a conservative JSON-Schema-like subset for tool schemas and custom validation. As bundled tools evolve, schemas may begin using keywords the validator does not enforce or intentionally ignores. That should be visible.

Acceptance criteria:
- Walk all bundled/default tool input schemas recursively.
- Collect every schema keyword used, including nested object/array/union schemas.
- Assert each keyword is either supported by the validator or explicitly allowlisted as provider-only/documentation-only.
- Add a regression test that fails if a new unsupported keyword appears silently.
- Keep the allowlist narrow and documented.
close_reason: Added recursive bundled-tool schema keyword coverage, with validated keywords and a narrow documented description allowlist.
